description: Ten example assets for the pixel-vfx sprite pipeline. Every entry names ONE distinct Kenney Particle Pack source asset (CC0-1.0) plus the converted motion system it is rendered with. kind=source-prefab: the sample prefab's own material texture. kind=source-texture-variant: a different distinct pack sprite rendered with a converted sample-prefab motion (labelled as a texture variant everywhere it is presented). Seeds are always the motion prefab's own baked randomSeed - never re-rolled.

examples.title: Fire
examples.notes: Sample prefab Fire rendered with its own material texture (Fire.mat mainTexture smoke_07.png). Bottom edge contact is intentional emitter-base framing (origin at cell base), not cropping.

examples.title: Smoke
examples.notes: Sample prefab Smoke rendered with its own material texture (Smoke.mat mainTexture smoke_01.png). Bottom edge contact is intentional emitter-base framing (origin at cell base), not cropping.

examples.title: Sparks
examples.notes: Sample prefab Sparks rendered with its own material texture (Trace.mat mainTexture trace_02_rotated.png).

examples.title: Magic
examples.notes: Sample prefab Magic rendered with its own material texture (Star.mat mainTexture star_06.png). Presentation: 192x192 cell, scale 16, origin (100,96), alphaThreshold 0.12, and view.startSize {state:3,min:0.4,max:1.6} scaled up for gallery legibility; source startSize {state:3,min:0.1,max:0.5} unchanged in examples/magic.json.

examples.title: Hearts
examples.notes: Sample prefab Hearts rendered with its own material texture (Heart.mat mainTexture symbol_01.png). Presentation: scale 18, origin (64,112), and view.startSize {state:3,min:0.3,max:2.5} scaled up for gallery legibility; source startSize {state:3,min:0.1,max:1.2} unchanged in examples/hearts.json.

examples.title: Electricity
examples.notes: Sample prefab Electricity rendered with its own material texture (Spark.mat mainTexture spark_05_rotated.png). Presentation override: source constant startSize serializes scalar=0.0 (renders no particles as-is); gallery renders view.startSize=1.0 taken from the serialized minScalar. Source records unchanged.

examples.title: Flame Jet
